name: Propose to Library
about: A Project Object goes to the shared Library: the code checks and names it, Claude reviews it when the review setting asks, you say go when there is a review to read, and its record becomes a pull request you merge.

input.about: A Project Object from your projects: tap Propose on the Library page (From your projects), or ask in a chat.

rules.text: Agents never change the Library, a project or the Object. They write only the run's data; here, a review.
The Library changes only by pull request, merged by the owner. This run's last step writes a proposal record; the content repository's GitHub Action turns it into that pull request.
A review never changes the Object. Only a missing description may be taken from the review's one-sentence about.
The review runs only when the shared setting library.review asks: always, or only when the code is unsure (the default), never when it is off.

steps.name: Prepare
steps.outcome: The Project Object passes the Library check, is not in the Library already, and has a Library name and version.

steps.name: Review
steps.outcome: A short review: does it look right for the Library, a one-sentence description, and what to look at.

steps.name: Send to the Library?
steps.question: Send this Object to the Library as a pull request?

steps.name: Send
steps.outcome: The proposal record is committed; GitHub turns it into a pull request for the owner to merge.

output.name: Proposal
output.about: The Object's Library name, the review if one ran, and whether its record was sent.
